description: This file defines a service module for calculating estimate totals within a project management or estimation tool. It includes data classes and functions to compute total hours and costs, and to generate detailed breakdowns per role and item, integrating data from a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models.

classes.name: EstimateTotals
classes.description: Container dataclass for totals and breakdowns of an estimate, including total hours, total cost, per-role breakdowns, and item summaries.

methods.name: Optional[float] _get_default_hours(db: Session, item_type: str, complexity: str)
methods.description: Fetches default hours for an item based on item type and complexity from the database.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[float,str]] _get_rate_for_role(db: Session, role: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the hourly rate and currency for a specified role from the RateCard.

methods.name: str _pick_role_for_item(item: EstimateItem)
methods.description: Determines a default role for an estimate item based on its item type.

methods.name: EstimateTotals calculate_totals(db: Session, estimate_id: int)
methods.description: Calculates total hours and costs for an estimate, including per-role and per-item summaries, using database data and logic for defaults and rate retrieval.

ctags.name: _get_default_hours
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_default_hours(db: Session, item_type: str, complexity: str) -> Optional[float]:$/
